task: ATTENDANCE UI REPAIR, REAL-TIME DATA INTEGRATION, AND DAILY ATTENDANCE LOGIC AUDIT

audit_findings_and_resolutions.defect: Attendance status legend displayed poorly aligned labels, inconsistent wrapping, and mixed academic policy text with legend items, creating visual clutter.
audit_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Replaced with compact Wrap layout containing structured status chips with aligned badges, short codes ([P], [A], [OD], [HD-P], [HD-A], [L], [-]), and status labels. Separated On Duty credit policy and non-teaching Lunch Break interval into a dedicated glassmorphism footer note.

audit_findings_and_resolutions.defect: Daily period schedule fabricated hardcoded fake period codes (19IT501..19IT507) and marked unrecorded periods as 'ABSENT', asserting false statements such as 'You missed 7 classes today'.
audit_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Wired period schedule strictly to the authenticated student's authoritative timetable (Class 1 / Class 4 CSE Cyber Security: FDS, DMC, FDS LAB, DPCO, OOPS, DS). Unrecorded periods display canonical 'No record' (Pending) in neutral amber, never fake Absent. Headline dynamically computes today vs past vs future unrecorded states honestly.

audit_findings_and_resolutions.defect: Daily attendance hero card displayed cumulative semester attendance instead of daily attendance for the active date. Date picker row suffered from horizontal RenderFlex overflow by 18 pixels on physical device.
audit_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Refactored _buildAttendanceHeroCard to calculate daily percentage strictly for the selected calendar date using scheduled teaching periods |S_d| from the timetable as denominator (excluding lunch/breaks). Date switcher row re-engineered with Expanded flexible center picker and compact chevrons, eliminating 100% of RenderFlex overflow.

audit_findings_and_resolutions.defect: Calendar matrix simulated fake attendance entries using pseudo-random formulas (seed = month * 31 + day) with mock course codes 19IT501..19IT505.
audit_findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Eliminated all pseudo-random simulation loops (lines 1438-1487). Unrecorded days strictly reflect NO_DATA / PENDING with timetable slots marked NOT_ENTERED. Dynamically initializes selected date from current calendar date or latest official record.
